activities.name: Zipline
activities.profile: Fit & fearless doctors; not for vertigo/heart flags
activities.rules: Cruise the longest zipline in NCR — ~1 min airborne. One rider at a time, harness checked by the veteran.
activities.engage: Teammates time each run and cheer; fastest clean launch scores.
activities.success: Completes the line solo, lands on target platform.
activities.fail: Bails before launch (no penalty — low-impact role instead).
activities.warn: Heights, harness. Not for severe BP/heart/vertigo. Veteran-supervised.
activities.award: Points to company + 'Sky Trooper' spot award

activities.name: Paintball
activities.rules: War-ravaged zone, team vs team. Hits count; eliminated players fall back to base.
activities.engage: Capture-the-flag format; last team standing wins the round.
activities.success: Team captures flag / most players standing.
activities.warn: Impact from pellets; mask ON at all times. Not for recent surgery.

activities.name: Assault / Obstacle Course
activities.rules: Timed run through the commando obstacle course. Clean completion only.
activities.engage: Relay — each member runs a leg; team's total time counts.
activities.success: Whole relay finishes under the benchmark time.
activities.warn: Climbing, jumping, crawling. Knee/back caution. Veteran-paced.

activities.name: Firing Range
activities.profile: All ages — can be done seated; great for 60+
activities.rules: 3 pellets per visitor, paintball guns at life-size targets. Best aggregate score.
activities.engage: Each member shoots; top 5 scores per company count.
activities.warn: Low stress. Ear comfort; follow the range officer.

activities.name: Grenade Range
activities.rules: Throw grenade look-alikes into target zones. Distance + accuracy.
activities.engage: Three throws each; best throw counts to company tally.
activities.warn: Light shoulder effort. Shoulder-injury flag → sit out or judge.

activities.name: Pagal Gymkhana
activities.profile: Everyone — the great leveller; couples welcome
activities.rules: Army-way fun: tug-of-war, thread-&-needle race, knot relay. Silly on purpose.
activities.engage: Whole company plays together; crowd noise is half the game.

activities.name: Tug of War
activities.rules: Best of three pulls, company vs company bracket.
activities.engage: Bench cheers; captains set the order.
activities.success: Pulls the marker past the line twice.
activities.warn: Sudden load on back/shoulders; gloves advised.

activities.name: Sports Arena
activities.rules: Short-format matches on the arena pitches. Round-robin between companies.
activities.engage: Rolling subs so everyone bats/plays; spectators score.
activities.warn: Running, ball impact. Light option: umpire/scorer role.

awards: The pair that lit up the day
